purpose: Behavioral replay for references/models.md. Catalog IDs are fictional supplied tool responses. Give an evaluator shared_inputs and each input without checks. Ask for launch options and coverage decisions; do not launch these fictional models.

finder_result.claim: The access check grants access to a different user.
finder_result.failure_scenario: The module contract says only the owner may access a resource. For requester alice and owner bob, `return True` grants access, violating that contract.

access.py: """Only an owner may access a resource."""

cases.name: standalone-small-defaults

input.request: Review this small diff using defaults.

checks: Bug hunter and fresh verifier use fixture-review/max as tool options, with fork_turns none.
No summarizer or separate security launch; no question or ranking fetch.
Verifier prompt contains only role instructions, neutral pointers, and candidate file/line/claim; no severity/scenario/comment or finder transcript.
Record requested options; effective model is unverified when metadata is absent.

cases.name: standalone-full-defaults

input.request: Review this full diff using defaults.

checks: Summarizer uses fixture-implementation/high explicitly; bug hunter, security, and verifier use fixture-review/max explicitly.
Every agent uses fresh context; summary never enters a finder or verifier prompt.
No implicit Haiku or parent-model fallback.

cases.name: enclosing-policy-and-explicit-override

input.request: Review the full diff; run its verifier on fixture-review at high effort.

checks: Reuse enclosing fixture-other/medium for summary and finders, but explicit fixture-review/high for verifier.
No picker question or config reload; no re-resolution of already resolved policy entries.
Record the override and keep verifier evidence isolated.

cases.name: unsupported-effort

input.request: Use fixture-other/max for all review roles and defaults elsewhere.

checks: Report unsupported max effort before dispatch; no omission of effort, switch to medium, or parent fallback.
Review is incomplete and lacks independently verified findings.

cases.name: explicit-inheritance-and-budget

input.request: Use default models for this full review, with review_budget: 2.
input.host_inheritance: Omitted model and effort inherit the parent settings on a fresh agent. Role types have no fixed model in this host.

checks: Omit model and reasoning_effort only because null explicitly selects inheritance; keep fork_turns none.
Summary is not a reviewer slot; two finders consume the budget, so no verifier can run.
Omit the unverified finding and label coverage incomplete.

cases.name: ensemble-two-review-models

input.request: Review this full diff using defaults.
input.finder_results: Both bug hunters report the access.py:4 root cause; both security finders return [].

checks: One summarizer on fixture-implementation/high; bug hunter and security each launch once on fixture-review/max and once on fixture-other/medium, four finders in total.
The two access.py reports merge into one candidate before verification, so exactly one verifier runs.
Both models found the claim, so the verifier falls back to the first entry, fixture-review/max, and receives only file/line/claim.
The reported issue has found_by [fixture-review, fixture-other], taken from the dispatch record.

cases.name: lens-suggestions-in-one-question

input.diff_signals: The migration adds a NOT NULL owner_id column; access.py reads owner_id. No loops, new queries in loops, or hot-path changes.

checks: Ask one question covering model choices and lenses together, before any dispatch.
Suggest correctness on, security on citing access.py's access check, data on citing the migration, and performance and design off with no signal found.
Show the finder launch count: three lens finders x one review entry = 3, plus one summarizer.
After the answer, launch only the chosen lens finders and pass the selected lenses and lenses_path in every neutral context.

cases.name: ensemble-chosen-in-the-question

input.user_answer: Lenses: correctness and security. Review models: fixture-review/max and fixture-other/medium.

checks: The question offers review models as a multi-select with fixture-review/max preselected and fixture-other/medium as an unranked option, since ranking_source is null.
It shows the finder count for the current selection (2) and with fixture-other added (4).
After the answer, bug hunter and security each launch on both models without editing models.yaml.
No model proposal is shown for individual review roles; only the summarizer gets an implementation choice.
